wp: WP1 - hypothesis-robust selection among existing models (no new model, no refit)
registered: 2026-10-16, before any WP1 score was computed
model_configuration: every model is evaluated in its submitted / registered configuration: eps = eps0 + 0.4 (EPS_EXTRA_AH = 0.4), main step method, A4 2 Ah. The label hypotheses vary the truth, not the model.

hypotheses.target: T_k(h) = Q_fc,k + eps0 + Delta - f * R_k + d * L_k, L_k = max(0, 100.41 - (Q_fc,k + eps0)); Q_fc,k from the full data (harness QFC)
hypotheses.R_k: round 4 stage_5 jumps.csv column recovery_Ah_with_aging for CK1..CK7

score: s_h(m) = mean(MAE_m / MAE_EX, RMSE_m / RMSE_EX, MAX_m / MAX_EX) over the checkups of a scenario, errors in pp against T(h); EX evaluated under the same h

grids.causal: PG1, PG2 (k 4..7), PC5, PC10 (k 3..7), CS, CSE (k 3..7); s per scenario, then the mean over the six scenarios; EX on a scenario uses that scenario's operation data

decision_quantities: max regret over h, regret = s_h(m) - min over candidates of s_h
expected s, diagnosis prior: f {0: 0.6, 0.5: 0.3, 1: 0.1}, d {0: 0.5, -0.031: 0.5}, Delta uniform
robust_choice: lowest real-grid max regret among candidates other than EX; ties within 0.01 (normalised score units) -> lower diagnosis-prior expectation; then report agreement with the causal grid and ranking stability under both priors
exposure_statement: real-grid values are exposed proxies; WP1 measures robustness to label uncertainty, not new accuracy evidence
